text:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: INCIDENT triggered — autoscaler failing to scale GPU nodes in aws-ap-east1. Observed: scale-up errors + quota denied. Impact: inference queue growth and elevated 429s. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-quota-ops (pinging oncall)

Erin (oncall): I'm on it. looking at autoscaler logs and cloud console. starting with recent scale attempts.

Erin (oncall): saw repeated errors in the last 6m:
```
autoscaler: scaleUp failed for nodegroup gpupool-ap-east1
error: QuotaExceeded: Request failed: "You have exceeded the quota for GPU resources in region aws-ap-east1" (API: CreateInstances)
attempts: 6
```

Raj: confirmed from cloud console: account-level GPU quota for this account in ap-east1 is fully consumed. no spare capacity to satisfy pods. also fairshare limits kicking in for some pools.

Jess: metrics: queue length = 18,542 (up from 1.2k an hour ago). 95th perc latency for short-text gen is 4.3s -> 8.9s. error rate (429/503) for hosted API increased to 4.7% overall, several customers reporting timeouts.

Lina (support): support ticket stream has 12 customers flagged, one enterprise (acct-ACME) reporting sustained request failures. I've flagged and started proactive messages: SUP-2142 created (ops aware).

Sam: quick mitigation options: 1) reroute new requests to fallback regions with capacity; 2) reduce concurrency / priority for batch queues; 3) abort low-priority jobs; 4) spin up smaller-VM inference nodes if model supports smaller instance flavor. however spinning more in ap-east1 will hit same quota.

Erin (oncall): starting reroute to us-west2 fallback pool (weight shift). executing safe command now (dry-run first).

Sam: dry-run output looks good. applying override.
```
# dry-run
redwood route update --from-region aws-ap-east1 --to-region aws-us-west2 --policy emergency --weight 100 --dry-run
# apply
redwood route update --from-region aws-ap-east1 --to-region aws-us-west2 --policy emergency --weight 100
```

deploy-bot: route update applied by Erin (oncall) at 5345680000 — traffic reroute in progress.

Jess: initial effect: queue growth slowed, new enqueues are landing in us-west2. we're still draining backlog in ap-east1; backlog draining rate ~1.2k jobs/min. error rate dropped from 4.7% -> 2.1% over last 3m.

Raj: opened a cloud support ticket for quota increase — AWS case #987654321. requested temporary quota bump for GPU instance family used by gpupool. included justification: production impact, mitigation in place.

Erin (oncall): also executed temporary throttle policy for embeddings to reduce token throughput:
```
redwood config set --service embeddings --concurrency 200 --region aws-ap-east1
```
This reduced outbound pressure.

Lina (support): continuing customer comms: proactive emails to affected customers, Slack DM updates for enterprise accounts. ACME CCM looped in.

Sam: cancelling queued low-priority batch jobs to free workers:
```
redwood jobs cancel --queue inference-batch --tag priority:low --reason "quota mitigation"
```
Cancelled ~4.2k jobs, freed ~600 concurrent slots.

Jess: visible improvements: backlog now 9,800 (from 18.5k). error rate steady at 1.0%. still watching tail latencies for dedicated customers.

Erin (oncall): summary of current state:
- Root cause: account GPU quota exhausted in aws-ap-east1 -> autoscaler scale-up denied.
- Impact: hosted API saw elevated 429/503s, backlog growth, higher latencies; some enterprise customers degraded.
- Mitigations applied: traffic reroute to us-west2, concurrency throttle for embeddings, cancelled low-priority batches, opened AWS support case, proactive customer comms.
- Next steps: track AWS quota ticket, consider short-term Dedicated placement for critical tenants, schedule follow-up to provision reserved capacity or shift critical workloads to Dedicated pools.

Raj: handoff: I'm taking night coverage; Erin please handoff any open links and the cloud case ID. I'll keep the reroute and throttles in place until quota increase confirmed. tagging oncall-2 for visibility.

Erin (oncall): handing over. Cloud case: AWS-987654321. Support expects initial response in 1-2 hours. links: SUP-2142 (customer comms), runbook /runbooks/gpu-quota-ops, route change pr (#6789). Logs and timeline saved to incident doc: /ops/incidents/5345678901.

Lina (support): leaving note for next oncall: monitor dedicated customers for throughput regressions. I'll maintain customer comms until resolved or escalated to CSM.

Sam: post-incident actions (to be tracked): 1) request permanent quota increases for affected regions; 2) add autoscaler telemetry to alert earlier when quota available vs refused; 3) runbook update to include faster regional reroute steps and verification checklist; 4) explore pre-warmed standby pools in low-cost regions for emergency soak.

Jess: current metrics at handoff: backlog 4,100 (draining), error rate 0.8%, avg latencies trending toward normal. marking incident as "mitigated" but not resolved until quota increase confirmed.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: incident state set to MITIGATED by Erin (oncall) at 5345682500.

Erin (oncall): handing final: Raj owns until quota is confirmed. If AWS case stalls, escalate to EngInfra lead and consider cross-account fallback plan.

Raj: ack, taking it. :thumbsup:
